metadata.title: Want to Test Tesla’s Full Self-Driving? You Can Now Rent It on Turo.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Want to Test Tesla’s Full Self-Driving? You Can Now Rent It on Turo.
Tesla’s Full Self-Driving software is a reason people are buying Teslas. Now, there is a new way for anyone to test out the system before forking over cash to Elon Musk’s EV maker.
